title: G2: compact worker packet — spawn.packet(task) rendered into execute and fix-round prompts at dispatch (objective, acceptance, base commit, write and read scope, symbols and tests per scope file, matching gotchas, verification command, evidence pointers), capped at about 1,200 tokens
spec:
Scout T-0262: execute.md fills only spec, acceptance, scope (270-char template, about 750 tokens rendered for T-0256) and tells the worker to implement then run tests; no recall or bus_read step; fix-delta.md fills n, failing_tests, assertion_lines; spawn.render is plain string substitution (spawn.py about line 70). Workers then spend their first turns on Grep and Read (T-0244: Grep, Read x5, Bash x3 before any edit).
Change:
1. spawn.packet(task, worktree) -> str, built without a model from data on disk, sections in this order: objective (title), acceptance (bullets), base (branch name, merge-base sha against the goal branch, goal id), write_scope (task scope), read_scope (directories of the scope paths plus tests/ and the modules imported by scope files, listed as paths), relevant_tests (tests/test_<module>.py for each scope module that exists, plus test names that mention a scope symbol, capped 15), symbols (top-level def and class names with line numbers per scope .py file via ast, capped 40 lines), gotchas (gotchas.md entries whose title or facts mention a scope path or module, as 'mem:gotchas.md:<line> <title>', capped 5), decisions (decisions.md entries naming the parent goal, titles only, capped 3), verify ('.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh .' and the failures-only convention), evidence (task inputs with their result summaries' first 200 chars). Hard cap: 4,800 characters, trimming from the bottom section up, with a final line 'packet truncated: N chars dropped; bus_read(task_id) has the full task'.
2. execute.md and fix-delta.md gain {{packet}} at the top; spawn.render callers for execute and fix rounds (daemon dispatch renders spawn.render('execute', ...); executor reply path renders fix-delta) pass packet=spawn.packet(...). The Codex path uses the same rendered prompt (daemon passes it to executor.start), so no executor.py change.
3. README: a 'Worker packet' paragraph in the Pipeline section listing the sections and the cap.
4. Tests in tests/test_spawn.py: test_packet_sections_in_order (fixture repo with one scope module and a test file), test_packet_cap_trims_bottom_first, test_execute_prompt_contains_packet, test_packet_gotcha_match_by_path.
acceptance: spawn.packet on T-0256's task json against this repo returns under 4,800 characters and names tests/test_bus.py and tests/test_handover.py under relevant_tests
README Pipeline section documents the packet
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
